name: Marketing Management II
description:
Marketing is everywhere — in what we buy, how we choose, and even how ideas
spread. Marketing is the study of transactions: how value is created, communicated,
and exchanged between individuals and organizations. In this course, we will explore
the core marketing concepts.
This course also serves as a stepping stone for more advanced marketing electives
and links marketing to the broader philosophy of management. We’ll try to keep it
practical wherever we can, using examples, cases, and simple tools. The idea is to
build a strong foundation
